recommendations.title: Enforce a 2 m person-stop on driverless stackers
recommendations.action: Enable person-detection interlocks (ceiling cameras + on-board sensors) that stop stackers when a worker is within 2 m; audit run 10's stacker firmware first.
recommendations.rationale: One collision and one near-miss in which the stacker never slowed down, plus a worker who stood in the stacker's path for ~3 s.
recommendations.expected_impact: Removes the highest-severity risk class seen this shift (2 high-severity alerts).

recommendations.title: Move 2 idle workers from the Camera_02 floor to the Camera inbound lane
recommendations.action: Re-assign 2 of the ~8.6 idle workers on Camera_02 to clear the zone (2,1) crossing on the Camera floor during peaks.
recommendations.rationale: Camera_02 runs at 61% idle while AGVs on the Camera floor drop to 50% moving at the zone (2,1) bottleneck.
recommendations.expected_impact: Camera_02 idle share from 61% toward ~45%; fewer AGV stops at zone (2,1).

recommendations.title: Re-route one parked AGV from Camera_02 to the robot lane
recommendations.action: Assign one of the parked Camera_02 AGVs to the Camera_01 lane loop and use lane zone (0,2) as its staging spot.
recommendations.rationale: AGV moving ratio on Camera_02 is 0.378; the lane zone (0,2) is nearly unused (0.0 occupants).
recommendations.expected_impact: +1 AGV in active transport without new hardware; frees floor space near the racks.

recommendations.title: Mark pedestrian exclusion zones around stacker turning areas
recommendations.action: Paint walkway lanes and a keep-out arc where stackers turn; add audible alerts when a stacker starts to turn.
recommendations.rationale: Both the near-miss (run 3) and the in-path event (run 7) happened where walking routes cross the stacker's turning circle.
recommendations.expected_impact: Fewer person-in-path exposures; clearer right-of-way for drivers and automation.

recommendations.title: Keep zone (1,1) on Camera_02 clear between 2:30 and 3:05
recommendations.action: Stagger breaks and route foot traffic around the centre zone during the AGV crossing window.
recommendations.rationale: Zone (1,1) averages 2.41 people in that window and the loaded-AGV proximity alert happened nearby.
recommendations.expected_impact: Lower proximity risk and smoother AGV flow through the centre aisle.

shift_report_md:
## Summary
5 safety events (2 high, 2 medium, 1 low severity) and 4 utilization flags across 3 floor cameras.

## Safety
- **Driverless stacker drives into a standing worker** (high, confidence 0.93): w3_run10 ceiling_00, t=4.5 s
- **Worker evades a turning stacker** (high, confidence 0.86): w3_run3 ceiling_01, t=3.0 s
- **Worker walks into the advancing stacker's path** (medium, confidence 0.81): w3_run7 ceiling_00, t=7.2 s
- **Loaded AGV passes within ~1 m of a worker** (medium, confidence 0.72): w017 Camera_02, t=227.0 s
- **AGV with cartons crosses close to an idle worker** (low, confidence 0.61): w017 Camera, t=1.5 s

## Fleet efficiency
| Camera | Machines moving | AGV moving | AGV loaded | AMR moving | Humanoid moving | Windows with motion |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| w017 Camera | 84% | 87% | 50% | 100% | 78% | 100% |
| w017 Camera_01 | 84% | 100% | 100% | 53% | 100% | 100% |
| w017 Camera_02 | 50% | 38% | 33% | 50% | 69% | 100% |

- Only 1.1 of 3 AGVs are moving on average on Camera_02 — the rest sit parked by the racks.
- Zone (0,2) of the robot lane averages 0.0 occupants; the lane carries 1.58 people on average — candidate staging area for parked AGVs.
- Centre zone (1,1) holds 2.41 people on average between 2:30 and 3:05 while AGVs cross it.
- AGV flow drops to 50% moving between 1:00 and 1:35 as workers cross zone (2,1) — AGVs wait for clearance.

## Actions
1. **Enforce a 2 m person-stop on driverless stackers**: Enable person-detection interlocks (ceiling cameras + on-board sensors) that stop stackers when a worker is within 2 m; audit run 10's stacker firmware first.
2. **Move 2 idle workers from the Camera_02 floor to the Camera inbound lane**: Re-assign 2 of the ~8.6 idle workers on Camera_02 to clear the zone (2,1) crossing on the Camera floor during peaks.
3. **Re-route one parked AGV from Camera_02 to the robot lane**: Assign one of the parked Camera_02 AGVs to the Camera_01 lane loop and use lane zone (0,2) as its staging spot.
4. **Mark pedestrian exclusion zones around stacker turning areas**: Paint walkway lanes and a keep-out arc where stackers turn; add audible alerts when a stacker starts to turn.
5. **Keep zone (1,1) on Camera_02 clear between 2:30 and 3:05**: Stagger breaks and route foot traffic around the centre zone during the AGV crossing window.
